metadata.quantum_depth_rationale: The task forwards VQE callbacks through quantum-chemistry solver factories, so correctness is mainly factory API plumbing.

task.problem_statement: Minimum eigensolver factories make it convenient to construct VQE-based solvers for electronic and vibrational structure problems, but they do not expose VQE's callback hook. Users who need to observe optimization progress, collect intermediate energies, or monitor long hardware-backed runs cannot pass a callback through these factories. The factories should support the same callback behavior as VQE while keeping their existing solver construction behavior.
requirements: VQEUCCFactory must accept an optional callback argument and expose it through a callback property.
VQEUVCCFactory must accept an optional callback argument and expose it through a callback property.
When either factory constructs a VQE solver, the configured callback must be passed to that VQE so it is invoked during optimization with the VQE callback arguments.
Additional keyword arguments supplied to the VQE-based factories must be forwarded to the constructed VQE solver.
Existing VQEUCCFactory and VQEUVCCFactory solver construction, ansatz setup, initial state handling, optimizer configuration, and energy calculation behavior must remain compatible.

interface.Name: VQEUCCFactory
interface.Input: constructor: quantum_instance, optimizer=None, initial_point=None, gradient=None, expectation=None, include_custom=False, ansatz=None, initial_state=None, callback=None, **kwargs
interface.Description: Constructs a VQE UCC minimum eigensolver factory while preserving callback and extra VQE keyword arguments for solver creation.

interface.Name: VQEUCCFactory.callback
interface.Description: Gets or sets the callback passed to VQE solvers created by the factory.

interface.Name: VQEUCCFactory.get_solver
interface.Description: Returns a VQE configured for the electronic structure problem, including the factory callback and forwarded VQE keyword arguments.

interface.Name: VQEUVCCFactory
interface.Input: constructor: quantum_instance, optimizer=None, initial_point=None, gradient=None, expectation=None, include_custom=False, ansatz=None, initial_state=None, callback=None, **kwargs
interface.Description: Constructs a VQE UVCC minimum eigensolver factory while preserving callback and extra VQE keyword arguments for solver creation.

interface.Name: VQEUVCCFactory.callback
interface.Description: Gets or sets the callback passed to VQE solvers created by the factory.

interface.Name: VQEUVCCFactory.get_solver
interface.Description: Returns a VQE configured for the vibrational structure problem, including the factory callback and forwarded VQE keyword arguments.
